signature: SUBROUTINE ZLAUNHR_COL_GETRFNP( M, N, A, LDA, D, INFO )

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix to be factored. On exit, the factors L and U from the factorization $A-S=L \, U$; the unit diagonal elements of L are not stored.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: d
params.reference: The diagonal elements of the diagonal M-by-N sign matrix S, $D(i) = S(i,i)$, where $1 \le i \le \min (M,N)$. The elements can be only ( +1.0, 0.0 ) or (-1.0, 0.0 ).

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
